newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBs seen pausing at around 124.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBs seen pausing at around 124.00.

text.p: The September 10-year Japanese government bond futures contract is likely to consolidate at around 124.00 on Tuesday after two days of gains.

"The market is focusing on how much further the yen will rise against the dollar (after overnight gains) and whether Tokyo stocks will stay firm (after falls on Wall Street on Monday). That is because there is nothing else we can talk about," said a market analyst at a city bank's securities unit.
Traders said the topside is seen capped at 124.20, where profit-taking emerged on Monday, and then at a key resistance point of 124.37.
The September ended at a session low of 123.91 on Monday after rising as high as 124.20.

"The rally until yesterday was a result of the market factoring in a worsening in the tankan. But some are concerned about the possibility that the tankan may show an improvement," said a dealer at another city bank's securities unit. The Bank of Japan releases its "tankan" corporate survey on June 25.
But the downside is seen underpinned by steady buying from investors in cash bonds, traders said.
"Given huge maturing JGBs (of some four trillion yen in June), buying is expected on dips," said the analyst.
